issues.description: The 'title' attribute of struct 'Book' is described in the problem statement as a String (the problem states: "A struct Book consists of two Strings title and author") and the client code constructs Book instances using String literals. However, in the solution implementation (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift) the Book struct declares 'let title: Int' (line 26). This Int vs String mismatch will cause compilation errors at Book construction sites (e.g., Book(title: "Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption", ...) in Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift) and prevents the code from matching the exercise specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the type of Book.title to String in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift. Replace the declaration 'let title: Int' with 'let title: String' so it matches the problem statement and the call sites that pass String literals. Rebuild to verify Book initializations in Client.swift compile successfully.
